name: Bríd the Singer

intro.text: Sean-nós is sung with your eyes closed and your heart open. Battles are the other way round.

win: Go hálainn. Beautiful. You fought like a good song: no two verses the same.
after: Every singer ornaments a song their own way. The old ones say you should never sing it the same way twice. My neighbour says I should never sing it at all.
